lines.4: No, no. That still doesn't mean I should let adrenaline take over.
lines.5: I have no desire... to get dragged into this.
lines.7: What if I stick my nose in and things end up like that again?
lines.8: 「Hey! Quit ignoring us and get over here, YO!」
lines.10: 「These are the only kind of men who ever approach me.」
lines.12: Oh, great. My body moved on its own...
lines.13: I could have left someone like her to fend for herself.
lines.14: 「Sorry about my friend. We'll be going now.」
lines.17: I take Yashi by the hand and try to get us out of there.
lines.18: 「Hold it, asshole! You think you can kick Taku in the leg and just walk away?」
lines.19: 「Come on. You guys aren't stupid enough to start a scene here, are you? Go find some other girls.」
lines.23: 「Oww... Why'd you have to hit me?」
lines.24: I hear cheers from somewhere behind him.
lines.25: Ah. He's showing off for his friends.
lines.26: Come on, I'm trying to settle this peacefully.
lines.28: I don't want this dragging on. Maybe I should just put them down.
lines.30: 「What's with this guy? Don't butt in when you're this weak.」
lines.32: And here they come, one after another.
